summary: The StudentProfileHistory module manages the historical records of student profiles, focusing on cohort and non-cohort data entries. It includes functionalities for displaying and managing sections such as certifications, safety, infection control, and occupational health. The system allows filtering between cohort and non-cohort history, displaying all relevant entries unless specific sections are chosen.
purpose: To provide a comprehensive historical record of student profiles, including various sections and data entries relevant to student management and compliance.

workflows.name: StudentProfileHistory Management
steps: Initialize the session and retrieve the student ID.
Load the student profile history page.
Display entries based on cohort or non-cohort settings.
Allow filtering of entries by screen section.
Display error or warning messages if applicable.
Handle actions such as navigation to enrollment details.

business_rules: Entries are filtered between cohort and non-cohort based on the query string.
Show all entries if HR information is accessible, otherwise filter out HR entries.
validations: Session must be active for data retrieval.
calculations: Format action dates and phone numbers for display.
conditions: Display HR sections only if allowed by session settings.
system_behavior: Retrieves student profile history based on session and filters applied.
Displays appropriate UI elements based on cohort settings.
dependencies: Database procedures for retrieving student profile history.
exceptions: Invalid StudentID leads to no data display.
